source_text: בְּ/גַת֙ אַל תַּגִּ֔ידוּ בָּכ֖וֹ אַל תִּבְכּ֑וּ בְּ/בֵ֣ית לְעַפְרָ֔ה עָפָ֖ר התפלשתי־־׃
english_snapshot: In Gath[a], do not tell it; in Acco, do not weep.[b] In Beth-leaphrah[c], roll yourself in the dust.

signals.text: The Hebrew form behind 'roll yourself' is written as first person ('I have rolled myself') in the consonantal text; many take it as an imperative here because of the context.

source_text: יָשׁ֣וּב יְרַֽחֲמֵ֔/נוּ יִכְבֹּ֖שׁ עֲוֺֽנֹתֵ֑י/נוּ וְ/תַשְׁלִ֛יךְ בִּ/מְצֻל֥וֹת יָ֖ם כָּל חַטֹּאותָֽ/ם־׃
english_snapshot: He will again have compassion on us[a]; he will subdue our iniquities[b]. He will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

signals.text: Hebrew reads 'their sins'; many translations render 'our sins' to harmonize with the earlier 'our iniquities.'
